title: 第324章 左右之间第323章 另一个故事下
slug: 模拟修仙杀我者恩人也
lines: 柳曲籽左瞧瞧，右看看，听的似懂非懂，一头雾水。
她其实不太明白。
这位客人和师傅似乎曾经认识，但关系并不深，对彼此都没什么印象了。
不过重逢即是缘分，至少师傅有个朋友，有个认识他的人不是？
柳曲籽甚至还想过，师傅是从石头里蹦出来的东西，没有亲人没有朋友，也没有感情。
像一只游离在人间之外的怪物，和世界没有任何联系。
但现在，柳曲籽发现原来师傅曾经也是个人，只不过现在极少做人事儿罢了。
王易并不知道徒弟在背后蛐蛐自己。
他走上台阶，对陈清月指了指门内。
有什么事进道观里面再说。
王易倒没有害人之心，他只是出于谨慎，提防一下陈清月背后的那位老仙人，那只老狐狸。
如果真如老道士所猜测的那样，老狐狸早已经加入了山主的阵营，那么此时此刻，或许她已经在暗中准备一些事情了。
陈清月略微思索，跟在王易身后，走上了台阶。
“吱嘎~”
道观的大门缓缓闭合，只剩下柳曲籽一个人站在门口。
她挑起眉头，想了想，然后转过身，睁着眼睛，小心谨慎的警惕着周围。
她要替师傅守好大门，免得被外人偷听，特别是一个神出鬼没的老道士。
“你是来找我的？”
免去不必要的寒暄，王易直截了当，对陈清月提出了一个问题。
陈清月也很干脆，点了点头。
“但不是我，是她们。”
她，们？
王易轻挑眉头，这个她是谁，他倒是有些猜想，但是们哪儿来的呢？
陈清月说：“你还记得陈忱吗？”
这个问题其实很有必要。
因为她不确定此时此刻的王易究竟是怎么想的，对待山主和仙人，对待彩莲真人是什么态度。
就像他可以不记得前世的水牛镇，可以忘记十多年前发生的事情，当然也可以忽视掉一个很久没有见过的人。
王易说：“我记得。”
他和陈忱上辈子还见过面。
陈清月说：“她的前世是二河主。”
王易表情平静，点了点头，这事儿他也早就知道了。
陈清月对于王易的态度有些意外，但也没有细想太多，她把陈忱身上发生的故事都讲述了一遍，当然，事先也得到了陈忱的同意。
王易默默听着，瞳孔深处悄然闪烁。
他听完了陈忱的故事，也听见了一朵长在山上的莲花。
陈忱和陈水仙早就认识，她们一起谋划了一件事，这件事还有许青禾的参与。
“所以她们是一伙儿的？”
content_en:
Liu Quzi looked left and right, half-understood and confused.
She doesn't really understand.
The guest and the master seemed to have known each other before, but their relationship was not deep and they had no impression of each other.
But reunion is fate. At least the master has a friend, someone who knows him, right?
Liu Quzi even thought that the master was something that jumped out of the stone. He had no relatives, no friends, and no emotions.
Like a monster wandering outside the human world, without any connection with the world.
But now, Liu Quzi discovered that the master was once a human being, but now he rarely does human things.
Wang Yi didn't know that his apprentice was cricketing him behind his back.
He walked up the steps and pointed to Chen Qingyue's door.
If you have anything to do, let’s talk about it inside the Taoist temple.
Wang Yi had no intention of harming anyone. He was just cautious and wary of the old immortal and old fox behind Chen Qingyue.
If, as the old Taoist priest guessed, the old fox had already joined the mountain master's camp, then at this moment, she might have been secretly preparing something.
Chen Qingyue thought for a moment and followed Wang Yi up the steps.
"Squeak~"
The door of the Taoist temple slowly closed, leaving only Liu Quzi standing at the door.
She raised her brows, thought for a moment, then turned around, opened her eyes, and carefully watched her surroundings.
She had to guard the door for her master to prevent outsiders from eavesdropping, especially an elusive old Taoist priest.
…
"Are you here to find me?"
Without unnecessary pleasantries, Wang Yi asked Chen Qingyue a question directly.
Chen Qingyue nodded simply.
"But it's not me, it's them."
She, they?
Wang Yi raised his eyebrows slightly. He had some guesses about who she was, but where did they come from?
Chen Qingyue said: "Do you remember Chen Chen?"
This question is actually very necessary.
Because she was not sure what Wang Yi was thinking at this moment, his attitude towards the mountain master and the immortal, and towards the real person Cailian.
Just like he could not remember the town of Buffalo in his previous life, he could forget what happened more than ten years ago, and of course he could ignore someone he hadn't seen for a long time.
Wang Yi said: "I remember."
He and Chen Chen had met in their previous life.
Chen Qingyue said: "She was the Lord of Erhe in her previous life."
"Oh."
Wang Yi looked calm and nodded. He already knew about this.
Chen Qingyue was a little surprised by Wang Yi's attitude, but she didn't think too much about it. She told all the stories that happened to Chen Chen, of course, with Chen Chen's consent in advance.
Wang Yi listened silently, his pupils flickering quietly.
After listening to Chen Chen's story, he also heard a lotus growing on the mountain.
Chen Chen and Chen Shuixian have known each other for a long time. They planned something together, and Xu Qinghe was also involved in this matter.
"So they are in the same group?"
"Yeah."
